title: Soundness of the 3-SAT to clique reduction
statement: Let $f$ be a 3-CNF formula consisting of $m$ clauses. If the conflict graph of $f$ has an $m$-clique, then $f$ is satisfiable.
hypotheses_covered: f is a 3-CNF formula (list of m 3-clauses)
its conflict graph has a clique of size m (the number of clauses)
replaced:
If the conflict graph of a 3-CNF formula $f$ with $m$ clauses contains an
$m$-clique, then $f$ is satisfiable:
$\mathtt{hasClique}\,(\mathtt{toCliqueGraph}\,f)\,f.\mathtt{length} \to
\mathtt{is3Satisfiable}\,f$.
